name: DocVQA: Visual Question Answering on Document Images
description: A pioneering Visual Question Answering (VQA) benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal reasoning over complex document images. Curated by the Computer Vision Center (CVC) at Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona. Contains 50,000 questions formulated over 12,707 document images sourced from the UCSF Industry Documents Library. Answering requires understanding typography, tables, multi-column layouts, diagrams, handwritten marginalia, and document structure.
